description: This file contains a test suite for POSIX thread yielding behavior, including functions to test thread scheduling and yield effects, using pthreads and Google Test framework.

methods.name: IsYielder
methods.description: Determines if a thread index is designated as a yielder for a given trial, alternating to prevent bias.

methods.name: YieldingEntryPoint
methods.description: Thread function that calls sched_yield repeatedly to simulate yielding behavior.

methods.name: UnyieldingEntryPoint
methods.description: Thread function that calls DoNotYield repeatedly to simulate non-yielding behavior.
